results.label: tertiary
reasons: Tertiary alcohols lack the carbon-bound H required by ordinary alcohol-to-carbonyl oxidation; no C–C cleavage is invented.

results.label: ether
reasons: No neutral saturated alcohol C–OH oxidation site was found; phenols, ethers, acids and ketones are not primary/secondary alcohol sites in this pathway.

results.label: aldehyde
reasons: Aldehyde-to-acid oxidation requires Further oxidation and Water / polar protic medium in this model. Constants, pH and isolated products are not predicted.

results.label: carboxylic acid
reasons: No neutral saturated alcohol C–OH oxidation site was found; phenols, ethers, acids and ketones are not primary/secondary alcohol sites in this pathway.

results.label: allylic
reasons: An additional alkene can undergo oxidant addition/side reactions; selective alcohol oxidation with its geometry preserved is not validated.

results.label: E allylic
reasons: An additional alkene can undergo oxidant addition/side reactions; selective alcohol oxidation with its geometry preserved is not validated.

results.label: propargylic
reasons: An additional alkyne can undergo oxidant addition/side reactions; selective alcohol oxidation with its geometry preserved is not validated.

results.label: conjugated diene
reasons: An additional alkene can undergo oxidant addition/side reactions; selective alcohol oxidation with its geometry preserved is not validated.

results.label: vicinal diol
reasons: Vicinal/geminal alcohol sites can involve oxidative cleavage or coupled chemistry; this hypochlorite one-site model does not validate that environment.

results.label: five-membered lactol risk
reasons: Oxidation can give a hydroxy carbonyl with a potential 5-membered hemiacetal/hemiketal closure and further oxidation; cyclization/lactonization is not modeled.

results.label: six-membered lactol risk
reasons: Oxidation can give a hydroxy carbonyl with a potential 6-membered hemiacetal/hemiketal closure and further oxidation; cyclization/lactonization is not modeled.

results.label: near chiral alpha carbonyl
reasons: Specified center at substrate atom 3 is adjacent to the new carbonyl; possible epimerization is not covered by distant-center retention.

results.label: unscreened fluorine
reasons: F at substrate atom 6 is outside the validated alcohol/hypochlorite oxidation spectator set.
The additional haloalkane group has no validated compatibility policy for alcohol oxidation; unsupported does not mean chemically incapable of oxidation.

results.label: amine
reasons: N at substrate atom 1 is outside the validated alcohol/hypochlorite oxidation spectator set.
The additional amine group has no validated compatibility policy for alcohol oxidation; unsupported does not mean chemically incapable of oxidation.

results.label: benzyl ether
reasons: Benzyl/allyl ether retention under this oxidant has not been validated; distance alone does not prove it inert.

results.label: hemiacetal
reasons: Geminal-diol/hemiacetal or nonordinary alcohol environments need separate oxidation/cleavage validation.
Select a primary (or methyl) saturated C–OH with at least two carbon-bound H; secondary/tertiary sites do not use this primary-only layer.

results.label: strained ring
reasons: The 3-membered ring at atoms 3, 4, 5 needs strain/ring-opening compatibility validation.

results.label: existing aldehyde competes
reasons: An existing aldehyde can undergo further oxidation; leaving it unchanged while oxidizing this alcohol needs separate chemoselectivity validation.
Aldehyde-to-acid oxidation requires Further oxidation and Water / polar protic medium in this model. Constants, pH and isolated products are not predicted.

results.label: ketone competes
reasons: Additional carbonyl halogenation/cleavage or coupled hydroxy-carbonyl chemistry is not validated by this alcohol oxidation policy.
